ownership_note: The working agreement assigns commissioned IP to JGA after full payment, with broad exploitation rights subject to participant/third-party constraints. These future customer-use options do not reserve a new Riseklix veto or amend that agreement.

options.definition: Preserve the research free to participating practitioners, as in the original concept.
options.boundary: Do not downgrade this to a teaser or invent individual-only restrictions to force a sale. Actual use boundaries must be discussed rather than presumed.
options.state: Existing concept benefit; precise later terms remain to be agreed.

options.definition: Specify the report/version and actual intended internal circulation or decision use where a paid proposition is useful.
options.boundary: First check overlap with contributor access and what genuinely additional entitlement/service is wanted.
options.state: Proposed customer-use definition; no right granted or price set.

options.definition: Define exact original material, attribution, channel, period and permitted alterations if the customer wants external use.
options.boundary: No third-party chart/report, participant identity, quote or implied endorsement included merely because JGA owns commissioned analysis.
options.state: Proposed option requiring content-level rights and later customer terms.

options.definition: Identify whether use is internal preparation, quotation in a client deliverable, client access to the report or wider resale.
options.boundary: No blanket sublicensing/client redistribution assumed; also do not declare it forbidden before JGA decides terms and underlying rights permit.
options.state: Open product-use choice, not a Riseklix veto over JGA work.

options.definition: Define actual audience, agenda, preparation, duration/capacity and follow-up if a briefing is part of the offer.
options.boundary: Not unlimited analyst inquiry, payroll compliance helpdesk, custom research, investment advice or recurring support.
options.state: Candidate servicing work to test and cost, not a contracted commitment.

options.definition: Describe the specific disclosed recognition and agreed research output/use.
options.boundary: No implied research endorsement, conclusion control, guaranteed return or unagreed exclusivity.
options.state: Candidate funding benefits; editorial/rights terms remain open.

options.definition: If requested, define a separate transparent access benefit and test participant fit/permissions and delivery capacity.
options.boundary: Research funding does not provide default contacts, individual answers, meeting lists or introductions. No actual access promised.
options.state: Potential separate combination, not included in the minimum draft.

options.definition: Specify the actual version/date of outputs. Assess whether later refreshes are wanted and economically deliverable.
options.boundary: No implied subscription, auto-renewal, future council tenure or indefinite updates from an annual concept.
options.state: Later scope/price decision; not part of current draft service.
